عُثْمَانٌ The young one of the [species of bustard called] حُبَارَى. (S, K.) ―
-b2- And The young one of the [serpent called] ثُعْبَان. (AA, K.) And, (K,) some say, (TA,) The serpent, (AA, K,) of whatever species it be: (AA:) or the young one thereof. (AA, Mgh, K.) And أَبُو عُثْمَانَ is a surname of The serpent; (K, TA;) mentioned by 'Alee Ibn-Hamzeh. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
